changelog: Supports apworld 0.7.0. Older apworlds still work.
Photo scoring: Good Technique and Multiple PKMN checks stay out of logic until you have the unlock item, under progressive_unlocks and separate_unlocks.
Film capacity is read from your yaml, and is now a logic requirement for 13 checks as the apworld intends.
Map fragments: courses unlock from <Course>: Map Fragment items when map_fragments is 2 or more.
Supports apworld 0.6.0: the six Oak reward checks are tracked, and the Rainbow Cloud goal follows your yaml (sign pictures or Pokemon pictures, and how many).
Mew and Poliwag are now in logic with either the Pokemon Food or the Pester Ball, matching the apworld.
Sandshrew's picture no longer shows as reachable with only the Dash Engine.
Fixed the Normal Pictures toggle icon not loading.
Checks your seed does not contain are now hidden, including the ones dropped by rng_checks and hard_checks such as Zubat (Cave): Multiple.
Fixed the Pokedex showing every Pokemon greyed, even ones you had photographed.
Unchecked sign pictures are darker, so the ones you have received stand out.
Restored the Pokemon sprites and Prof. Oak icon for check state, by popular request.
Fixed five Multiple checks (Arcanine, Cloyster, Dratini, Magikarp, Psyduck) being hidden by a leftover Manual-world visibility rule.
All checks are now visible before connecting to a room, instead of only after.
Removed the Hard Checks toggle, which no longer controlled anything.
Added versions.json so PopTracker can offer updates automatically.
Retargeted to the native Pokemon Snap apworld, world_version 0.4.0.
All 200 locations autotrack, including the three secret exits.
Access rules corrected to match the apworld's logic.
Removed five locations that only existed in the Manual implementation.
Checks now use PopTracker's standard closed/open chest icons.
The starting course's map tab opens automatically on connect.
